title: metadata platform record: second follow-ups after #37604 (body-only readers, sentinel in restoreVersion, compiled CHANGELOG wording)
body:
repo:objectstack#6 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjQkY5yXZrN9BEA3rEK

Filing gate: ③ follow-up of an accepted delivery. Nits recorded by contract review PASS 7199461447 on PR #37640 (card #37604), plus the dev's out-of-scope flags in report 7199253774. None affects the verdict. One card covers the family.

- N2 — `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts` still reads the platform mark off the body only in `platformRow` (write path), `taken` and the non-slotted `platformOnly` branch of `delete`; `isPlatformRecordRow` is the shared reader. Rows the pre-#37604 adoption already rebound keep the mark under a package column; for a non-slotted type the withdrawal's body-only read could take such a row. Read, not measured: measure first, then switch to the shared reader or say why not.
- N1 — `SysMetadataRepository.restoreVersion` computes `intoPackageId` from the raw `opts.packageId` or raw column, without the `sys_metadata` sentinel normalisation the shared reader and the `DatabaseLoader` door apply. No current writer stores the sentinel in that column; align the two doors.
- Prose — the compiled prerelease CHANGELOG entries of `@objectstack/metadata` and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (from `.changeset/pre/37013-platform-skill-own-slot.md` and `.changeset/pre/37130-platform-record-restore-doors.md`) still carry "of a failed batch row write" (#37423 L2 N3) and the re-save prescription without the boot qualifier (#37423 L2 N1). A docs-only fix to those entries.

Suggested-grade: p3 · consistency and prose; N2 is the one that could touch a row and needs a measurement first.
Dedupe: `isPlatformRecordRow`, `platformOnly`, `restoreVersion intoPackageId` found only #37604 and PR #37640.
